name: RC-B10-0335/2025 – After recital D – Am 10
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the urgent need to protect religious minorities in Syria following the recent terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus
part_text: Da. whereas the interim Syrian constitution ratified in March 2025 enshrines Islamic law as the primary source of legislation, raising concerns about restrictions on individual rights, particularly those of women; whereas in June 2025, the Syrian Ministry of Tourism enacted new restrictive legislation on women’s attire in line with Islamic teachings on female chastity;
